{"id":1842896033,"question_id":4141,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1764470438,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"159 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1842896033/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Elements With at Least K Greater Values","memory":"184.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countElements(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        if(k == 0) return n;\n\n        vector<int>copy = nums;\n        sort(copy.rbegin() , copy.rend());\n\n        int elem = copy[k-1];\n        int ans = 0;\n        for(auto n : nums){\n            if(n < elem) ans++;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-elements-with-at-least-k-greater-values","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1217}
